name: Scary Baboon: Spooky Baboon
summary:
Scary Baboon received its Halloween-themed “Spooky Baboon” update on October 9, 2026.

The seasonal update introduces a Halloween makeover across the game, alongside themed enemies and activities. New additions include Pumpkin Meatman, a Halloween variant of the existing Meatman boss, and the Mimic Monster.

The update also adds a limited-time Trick or Treat event. During the event, players have eight minutes to collect 50 pieces of candy while exploring the game.

Spooky Baboon is available as a seasonal update for Scary Baboon on Meta Quest.
